crossRefs.note: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, But his latter end shall…
for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident…

people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt;
translations.bsb: Remember what the Amalekites did to you along your way from Egypt,
translations.kjv: Remember what Amalek did unto thee by the way, when ye were come forth out of Egypt;
translations.asv: Remember what Amalek did unto thee by the way as ye came forth out of Egypt;
